title: Light Weight
text: Light Weight. This is set of 8 towels. It comes with 2 bath towels, 2 hand towels, and 2 wash cloths. The sizing is standard and they are comparable to other towel sizing. The towels are light weight and moderately fluffy. I was disappointed in the quality. They're okay, just not great. If saw these in person at the store, I probably wouldn't get them. However, if I was just starting out and these were the cheapest towels in the store, I would consider them. There were a lot of pulled threads on them which you can see in the picture. Overall, they're just okay.
